```text
--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 5m29s | run 20261112-193422-hunt-19dc | 6 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3791

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Dashboard 'Recent waterings' renders a malformed response as rows of 'Never' instead of an error
   where: / (dashboard), GET /api/waterings?limit=5
   expected: A non-list response shows an error message in the Recent waterings section
   saw: {"never":14,"alerts":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-193422-hunt-19dc/probes/malformed.mjs (expectation "dashboard-malformed-shows-error-not-rows")
2. HIGH   Waterings page crashes on a non-list response (reduce is not a function), navigation never completes
   where: /waterings, GET /api/waterings
   expected: A visible error on the Waterings page
   saw: {"alerts":[],"text":["Partial shade","Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS","2","HARVESTED","2.55 kg","LAST WATERED","12 Nov 2026, 19:35","Water now"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-193422-hunt-19dc/probes/malformed.mjs (expectation "waterings-malformed-shows-error")
3. MEDIUM Past watering accepts year-1 date and reports it as recorded
   where: /beds Record past watering form, POST /api/waterings
   expected: An absurd far-past date such as 0001-01-01 is refused with a reason
   saw: {"alerts":["Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1."],"added":1}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-193422-hunt-19dc/probes/past-form.mjs (expectation "year-1-date-refused")
4. MEDIUM Waterings page load error offers no way to retry
   where: /waterings
   expected: After a failed load, a Retry / Try again control once the fault clears
   saw: {"retry":0}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-193422-hunt-19dc/probes/waterings-page.mjs (expectation "load-error-has-retry")
5. MEDIUM Dashboard recent waterings error offers no way to retry
   where: / (dashboard) Recent waterings
   expected: A retry control next to the 'could not load' error
   saw: {}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-193422-hunt-19dc/probes/past-form.mjs (expectation "dashboard-waterings-retry")
6. LOW    Filter by unknown bed id shows 'No waterings for this bed' while the Bed select shows no selection
   where: /waterings?bed=99999
   expected: The select and the list agree (unknown bed reset to All beds or flagged)
   saw: {"sel":"","selText":"(none)","text":["Shade corner","Clear filter","0 waterings","No waterings for this bed","Pick another bed or record a watering on the beds page.","Clear filter","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-193422-hunt-19dc/probes/malformed.mjs (expectation "unknown-bed-filter-consistent")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
```
